title: Tokimon — devlog
subtitle: Notes from building Tokimon: the pixel-art pipeline, the generative tooling, and what the art actually cost.

posts.title: Notes on making AI-generated pixel art usable
posts.description: All the art is generated. Generating it took an afternoon. Getting it to a state where it could ship took considerably longer, and most of that time went into finding out how the output was wrong.
